description: Yes, lighting in showers and wet bathroom areas needs special wet-location rated fixtures to prevent electrical hazards. This ensures safety and compliance.

mainEntity.name: Do I need special lighting for a shower or wet area in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you need special lighting for showers or wet areas in a bathroom. Fixtures installed directly inside a shower or above a tub must be rated for wet locations, meaning they are sealed against moisture intrusion. Look for fixtures with an IP (Ingress Protection) rating suitable for direct water exposure. Using inappropriate fixtures can pose electrical hazards in these environments. We ensure all wet location lighting installations meet safety standards for homes in areas like Oakland and beyond.
